author: Davidgo5867

english.text: One day, Kateb Yacine, our great writer, and famous playwright, was called to receive a prize. As he walked onto the stage, he stumbled and some people laughed. He turned around and said to them, "La Fontaine made the animals laugh and today I made you laugh!" This story could have happened and is very believable and timeless, even if it was necessarily spread by word of mouth. Kateb Yacine was a great humble artist and was said to drink immoderately and, as an opponent on principle, he was best known for his escapades.

jyutping: jau5 jat1 jat6，ngo5 dei6 ge3 wai5 daai6 zok3 gaa1、zyu3 ming4 kek6 zok3 gaa1 Kateb Yacine bei6 giu3 heoi3 ling5 zoeng2。 keoi5 haang4 soeng5 toi4 go2 zan6，dit3 dit3 zong6 zong6，jau5 di1 jan4 siu3 zo2。 keoi5 zyun3 san1 tung4 keoi5 dei6 gong2：「laai1 fong1 daan1 ling6 dou3 di1 dung6 mat6 siu3，ji4 gam1 jat6 ngo5 ling6 dou3 nei5 dei6 siu3！」 ni1 go3 gu3 si6 bun2 loi4 ho2 ji5 faat3 sang1，ji4 ce2 hai6 fei1 soeng4 ho2 seon3 tung4 wing5 hang4，zau6 syun3 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hai6 hau2 ji5 soeng1 cyun4。 Kateb Yacine hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 him1 heoi1 ge3 ngai6 seot6 gaa1，geoi3 gong2 keoi5 jam2 zau2 m4 sik1 loeng6，zok3 wai4 jyun4 zak1 soeng6 ge3 deoi3 sau2，keoi5 zeoi3 ceot1 meng2 hai6 keoi5 ge3 tou4 bei6 hang4 wai4。
text: 有一日，我哋嘅偉大作家、著名劇作家 Kateb Yacine 被叫去領獎。 佢行上台嗰陣，跌跌撞撞，有啲人笑咗。 佢轉身同佢哋講：「拉方丹令到啲動物笑，而今日我令到你哋笑！」 呢個故事本來可以發生，而且係非常可信同永恆，就算佢一定係口耳相傳。 Kateb Yacine 係一個好謙虛嘅藝術家，據講佢飲酒唔適量，作為原則上嘅對手，佢最出名係佢嘅逃避行為。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: First of all, our hearts go out to the families of those who have been killed. Our prayers go to those who have been wounded. This is a devastating attack on all Americans. It is one that is particularly painful for the people of Orlando, but I think we all recognize that this could have happened anywhere in this country. And we feel enormous solidarity and grief on behalf of the families that have been affected.

text: 首先，我哋嘅心都係向嗰啲被殺嘅人嘅家屬表達。我哋嘅祈禱係向嗰啲受傷嘅人祈禱。呢個係對所有美國人嘅毀滅性攻擊。呢個對奧蘭多嘅人嚟講係特別痛苦嘅，但我諗大家都認同呢個可能喺呢個國家嘅任何地方發生。而我哋代表受影響嘅家庭感到巨大嘅團結同悲傷。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In university, in Canada, I learned two different kinds of English, technical English and non-technical English, from different courses. I learned that the passive voice, as in "The cat was chased by the dog," is unacceptable in non-technical style, but technical writers use it frequently and legitimately. I learned in technical English that one should use demonstrative pronouns like "this" and "that" with a substantive, not by themselves. There were a lot of nuts and bolts.

jyutping: hai2 daai6 hok6，hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6，ngo5 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 fo3 cing4 jap6 min6 hok6 zo2 loeng5 zung2 m4 tung4 ge3 jing1 man2，gei6 seot6 jing1 man2 tung4 fei1 gei6 seot6 jing1 man2，ngo5 hok6 dou3 bei6 dung6 seng1，zau6 hou2 ci5「maau1 bei6 gau2 zeoi1」gam3，hai2 fei1 gei6 seot6 fung1 gaak3 jap6 min6 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 zip3 sau6 ge3，daan6 hai6 gei6 seot6 zok3 gaa1 zau6 ging1 soeng4 tung4 hap6 faat3 gam2 jung6 keoi5。 ngo5 hai2 gei6 seot6 jing1 man2 jap6 min6 hok6 dou3，jan4 jing1 goi1 jung6「nei1 go3」tung4「go2 go3」ni1 di1 zi2 si6 doi6 ming4 ci4 tung4 sat6 mat6 jat1 cai4 jung6，ji4 m4 hai6 zi6 gei2 jung6。 go2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 lo4 mou5 tung4 lo4 saan1。
text: 喺大學，喺加拿大，我喺唔同嘅課程入面學咗兩種唔同嘅英文，技術英文同非技術英文，我學到被動聲，就好似「貓被狗追」咁，喺非技術風格入面係唔可以接受嘅，但係技術作家就經常同合法噉用佢。 我喺技術英文入面學到，人應該用「呢個」同「嗰個」呢啲指示代名詞同實物一齊用，而唔係自己用。 嗰度有好多螺母同螺栓。
